statement: The maintainer reported DualSense virtual-controller trigger movement yielded no visible movement in a Steam test while some Sony controls differed between Steam and Eden.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad alpha-1 historical observation, pinned document c60c1640
applicability.scope: User-reported manual test, exact Steam/Eden versions and mappings absent. Uncorroborated and not proof of wire-axis error or physical DualSense behavior.
